answer: Resist Sybils with proof-of-useful-work rent: every epoch, each identity gets one shard of real research — a protein fold, a climate cell — and must return a verifiable result before the epoch closes. A jury spot-checks; forged shards burn the stake. An honest operator pays a slice of idle GPU, but an attacker with N fake identities must burn N times that compute, since proofs bind to identities and cannot split across clones. Completed shards become a public relic, and basalt math means a hundred voices need a hundred labs. Real compute is the network's nectar — and it cannot be faked.
